svg.title: The permitted service has an outward path
svg.desc: Magnify the service-access card within its source frame. The outward route illustrates an affordance only; do not connect it to a later exploit or particular run.

The outward route illustrates an affordance only; do not connect it to a later exploit or particular run.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "folder", "box": [ 0.1044, 0.2242, 0.292744, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PACKAGE SERVICE", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.5, 0.2242, 0.292744, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "OUTWARD PATH", "label_box": [ 0.492, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.412968, 0.3202, 0.0736, 0.0416 ], "color": "steel" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "route", "source": "
**Location:**

- `training-configuration`
- `artifactory-cache`

**Frame:** The fourth card enlarges and is bracketed on its own. Behind it, the same package-service silhouette that will recur through Chapters 1, 2 and 3, drawn once, plainly, with an outward arrow.

**Action:** The one door in the wall is identified before anyone walks through it.

**Caption:**
> THE MODEL HAS NO WAY OUT.
>
> THE SERVICE IT IS ALLOWED TO USE DOES.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-BH` 9:34–9:40, where OpenAI's own speaker identifies this arrangement as the crux of the incident. The caption compresses that statement; it is not agent reasoning and no agent has noticed it yet.
